blocks.orig: Serengeti lodges or camps: which is best?
blocks.html: Lodge or camp in the Serengeti: which is best?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose to stay in a luxury Serengeti lodge or you opt for a tented camp, you can be assured that you will be treated to a comfortable, safe and, most importantly, unforgettable experience in the Serengeti. Serengeti lodges are permanent structures in the national parks. Often located on vast land areas, they offer privacy and unbeatable comfort for those looking for a more luxurious taste of the Serengeti.
blocks.html: Pick a luxury Serengeti lodge or go for a tented camp: either way you can count on a comfortable, safe and, above all, unforgettable stay in the Serengeti. A Serengeti lodge is a permanent building inside the national park. Lodges often sit on large plots of land, giving privacy and exceptional comfort to anyone after a more luxurious take on the Serengeti.

blocks.orig: Tented camps also offer a luxurious experience – albeit with a few more basic facilities. All Serengeti camping accommodation with Your Tanzania Trip comes with a private tent and en suite bathroom facilities. The walls may be thin, but that offers a deeply immersive experience of the Tanzanian wild.
blocks.html: A tented camp is luxurious too, though the facilities are a little more basic. Every Serengeti camp stay booked through Your Tanzania Trip includes your own tent with an en suite bathroom. The canvas walls are thin, but that is exactly what brings you so close to the wild side of Tanzania.

blocks.orig: The Sound of Silence is one of the best safari camp options in the Serengeti with Your Tanzania Trip. Located in the heart of the Serengeti, the Sound of Silence Tanzania tented resort offers roomy 50-square-metre tents. Each guest enjoys high-quality linen, duvets, and mattresses. Accompanied by the sound of the Serengeti, they say that a night in the Sound of Silence guarantees the best night’s rest you’ll ever have! Hot and cold water is on tap, and the 24-hour electricity and Wi-Fi connection come from the camp’s own solar plant.
blocks.html: The Sound of Silence ranks among the finest safari camps Your Tanzania Trip offers in the Serengeti. Set in the centre of the park, this Tanzanian tented resort has spacious tents of 50 square metres, and every guest sleeps on top-quality mattresses with fine linen and duvets. With the Serengeti as your soundtrack, the camp claims that a night here will be the best sleep you've ever had! Hot and cold running water is available, while round-the-clock electricity and Wi-Fi are powered by the camp's own solar installation.

blocks.orig: Kubu Kubu: Luxury Lodge in the Serengeti
blocks.html: Kubu Kubu: a luxury lodge in the Serengeti

blocks.orig: For those looking for a little more luxury in their Serengeti vacation, a luxury lodge such as Kubu Kubu is one of our top recommendations. Located in the middle of the endless plains of the Serengeti, the Kubu Kubu lodge delivers spectacular views from each chic and comfortable room. Just some of their many other facilities include a large swimming pool, excellent dining areas and talented chefs. Impeccable service round the clock comes as standard!
blocks.html: If you'd like a touch more luxury on your Serengeti holiday, a lodge such as Kubu Kubu is among our top picks. Standing in the middle of the Serengeti's endless plains, Kubu Kubu offers breathtaking views from every stylish, comfortable room. Among its many other amenities are a large swimming pool, excellent dining spaces and skilled chefs, and attentive service around the clock is simply part of the package!

blocks.orig: With more facilities to keep kids entertained and experienced staff on hand to ensure your safari trips run smoothly, choosing a Serengeti lodge is also often an excellent option for travelling with children in Tanzania.
blocks.html: A Serengeti lodge also tends to be an excellent choice for families with children in Tanzania: there is more to keep the kids busy, and experienced staff make sure your safari outings go smoothly.
